task_completion.description: Open the Screaming Frog SEO Spider application.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Screaming Frog SEO Spider GUI is visible on the desktop.

task_completion.description: Enter 'https://books.toscrape.com/' into the address bar and start the crawl.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The URL 'https://books.toscrape.com/' is in the address bar and the progress bar shows crawl activity or completion.

task_completion.description: Configure or run Content Analysis to calculate readability metrics.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Content' tab is selected, and columns like 'Flesch Reading Ease Score' are populated with numerical data.

task_completion.description: Export the Content analysis data to the specified CSV path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An export dialog or a file explorer window shows 'readability_audit.csv' being saved to '~/Documents/SEO/exports/'.

task_completion.description: Identify the URL with the lowest Flesch Reading Ease score.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent sorts the 'Flesch Reading Ease Score' column in ascending order or highlights a specific low-scoring row.

task_completion.description: Save the URL with the lowest score to the specified text file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A text editor or file explorer shows 'hardest_to_read.txt' being saved to '~/Documents/SEO/reports/' containing a URL.

integrity.description: The agent used the Screaming Frog GUI rather than just command-line scripts to generate results.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements, menu clicks, and the Screaming Frog interface being actively manipulated.

integrity.description: The agent actually performed a crawl of the site rather than opening a pre-existing file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The 'Internal' tab shows a list of URLs from books.toscrape.com with 200 OK status codes appearing during the session.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply echo the answer into a text file without using the SEO tool.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen interacting with the 'Export' button in Screaming Frog or the 'Bulk Export' menu.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The target URL is https://books.toscrape.com/. The required export path for the full CSV is /home/ga/Documents/SEO/exports/readability_audit.csv. The required report path for the lowest score is /home/ga/Documents/SEO/reports/hardest_to_read.txt. In Screaming Frog, readability metrics are found under the 'Content' tab and the specific column name is 'Flesch Reading Ease Score'. The agent must enable 'Readability' in the Content Analysis configuration (Config > Content > Analysis) for these scores to populate.
